description: Added map data for Occult Crescent zones, South Horn and North Horn.
Updated eureka-canvas to v3.0. Refactored zone data to simplify making new zones.
Rebuilt from the ground up with Vue 3, TypeScript, and Nuxt for server-side rendering and proper URLs.

Initial launch. Interactive maps for all four Eureka zones (Anemos, Pagos, Pyros, Hydatos) and the Bozjan Southern Front. Filterable monsters, FATEs, enemies, skirmishes, critical engagements, and more.
